name: Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. III Units
summary: Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. III operates as a blank check company. It is formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded by Michel Combes and Andrew Stephen Gundlach on April 1, 2026 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
